## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Verification

List executed commands, firmware model/OS and results. State unexecuted hardware
checks separately. Attach redacted evidence where useful.

## Security and compatibility

Describe any effects on PINs, consent, keys, USB, storage, backup or recovery.

- [ ] Scope is focused and upstream notices are preserved.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] User-facing strings are available in English and French.
- [ ] Logs and images contain no real secrets or private device identifiers.
